articles.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
articles.description: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

articles.title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad
articles.description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the execution of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

articles.title: Russell Brand accuser says alleged rape left her afraid she may be pregnant
articles.description: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

articles.title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
articles.description: Reservoir levels continue to drop after a hot summer and less September rain than normal.
